mapper.insert: INSERT INTO funding_backfill_request (request_key, instrument_id, window_start, window_end, page_limit) VALUES (#{requestKey}, #{instrumentId}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{pageLimit}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM funding_backfill_request WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM funding_backfill_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.request_key AS request_key, r.id AS request_id, r.current_run_id AS run_id, r.instrument_id, r.page_limit AS page_limit, ar.started_at FROM funding_backfill_request r JOIN analysis_run ar ON ar.id = r.current_run_id WHERE r.state = 'RUNNING' AND ar.started_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) - INTERVAL #{micros} MICROSECOND ORDER BY ar.started_at
mapper.update: UPDATE funding_backfill_request SET state = 'RUNNING', current_run_id = #{runId}, next_attempt = next_attempt + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'IDLE' AND current_run_id IS NULL
